marker-end="url(#arrO)"></line></svg></div> <p class="diagram-note">Sequenzdiagramm: Ablauf des synchronen/asynchronen Go-to-Sleep-Übergangs von ComM über LinSM und LinIf zu Treiber und Transceiver. Quellen: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00036" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00036">[SWS_LinSM_00036]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00204" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00204">[SWS_LinIf_00204]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00757" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00757">[SWS_LinIf_00757]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00758" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00758">[SWS_LinIf_00758]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00759" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00759">[SWS_LinIf_00759]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00135" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00135">[SWS_LinSM_00135]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00233" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00233">[SWS_LinSM_00233]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00002" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00002">[SWS_LinTrcv_00002]</a>.</p> <p>Das Aufwecken (Wakeup) erfolgt entweder aktiv durch Aussenden eines Wakeup-Pulses via <code>Lin_Wakeup</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00169" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00169">[SWS_Lin_00169]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00205" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00205">[SWS_LinIf_00205]</a>) oder intern ohne Bus-Puls via <code>Lin_WakeupInternal</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00256" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00256">[SWS_Lin_00256]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00262" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00262">[SWS_Lin_00262]</a>). Wakeup-Ereignisse von Hardware oder Transceiver werden über <code>Lin_CheckWakeup</code>, <code>LinTrcv_CheckWakeup</code> und <code>LinIf_CheckWakeup</code> gepoolt oder durch Interrupts verarbeitet (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00160" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00160">[SWS_Lin_00160]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_00012" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_00012">[SWS_LinTrcv_00012]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00378" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00378">[SWS_LinIf_00378]</a>). Der Treiber bzw. Transceiver meldet die Quelle über <code>LinIf_WakeupConfirmation</code> an <code>LinIf</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00715" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00715">[SWS_LinIf_00715]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinTrcv_91002" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinTrcv_91002">[SWS_LinTrcv_91002]</a>), welches <code>&lt;User&gt;_WakeupConfirmation</code> bedient und so <code>LinSM_WakeupConfirmation</code> erreicht (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00522" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00522">[SWS_LinIf_00522]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00761" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00761">[SWS_LinIf_00761]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00762" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00762">[SWS_LinIf_00762]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00132" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00132">[SWS_LinSM_00132]</a>). Um Buskollisionen bei wiederholten Aufweckversuchen zu vermeiden, startet <code>LinSM</code> einen Silence-After-Wakeup-Timer (<code>LinSMSilenceAfterWakeupTimeout</code>) und verzögert erneute Wakeup-Anforderungen bis zu dessen Ablauf (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00234" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00234">[SWS_LinSM_00234]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00235" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00235">[SWS_LinSM_00235]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00236" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00236">[SWS_LinSM_00236]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00237" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00237">[SWS_LinSM_00237]</a>).</p> <h4>6. Fehlerbehandlung, Det-Tracing und Degradation</h4> <p>Das Modulcluster implementiert mehrstufige Strategien zur Fehlerbehandlung über den Default Error Tracer (DET), das Diagnostic Event Manager (DEM) und autonome Signalisierungsmechanismen. Entwicklungsfehler werden über <code>Det_ReportError</code> erfasst: Bei uninitialisiertem Aufruf erzeugen die Module <code>LIN_E_UNINIT</code>, <code>LINIF_E_UNINIT</code> bzw. <code>LINSM_E_UNINIT</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00235" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00235">[SWS_Lin_00235]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00258" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00258">[SWS_Lin_00258]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00376" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00376">[SWS_LinIf_00376]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00053" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00053">[SWS_LinSM_00053]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00240" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00240">[SWS_LinSM_00240]</a>). Ungültige Kanal- oder Netzwerk-Parameter führen zu <code>LIN_E_INVALID_CHANNEL</code>, <code>LINIF_E_NONEXISTENT_CHANNEL</code> oder <code>LINSM_E_NONEXISTENT_NETWORK</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00259" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00259">[SWS_Lin_00259]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00376" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00376">[SWS_LinIf_00376]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00818" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00818">[SWS_LinIf_00818]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00831" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00831">[SWS_LinIf_00831]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00835" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00835">[SWS_LinIf_00835]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00843" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00843">[SWS_LinIf_00843]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00849" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00849">[SWS_LinIf_00849]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00853" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00853">[SWS_LinIf_00853]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00855" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00855">[SWS_LinIf_00855]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00239" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00239">[SWS_LinSM_00239]</a>). Zeiger- und Parameterfehler werden mit <code>LINIF_E_PARAM_POINTER</code>, <code>LINIF_E_PARAMETER</code> bzw. <code>LINSM_E_PARAM_POINTER</code> und <code>LINSM_E_PARAMETER</code> gemeldet (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00819" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00819">[SWS_LinIf_00819]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00820" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00820">[SWS_LinIf_00820]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00821" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00821">[SWS_LinIf_00821]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00827" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00827">[SWS_LinIf_00827]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00832" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00832">[SWS_LinIf_00832]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00836" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00836">[SWS_LinIf_00836]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00844" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00844">[SWS_LinIf_00844]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00845" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00845">[SWS_LinIf_00845]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00850" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00850">[SWS_LinIf_00850]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00053" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00053">[SWS_LinSM_00053]</a>). Hardware-Register-Timeouts im LIN-Treiber werden durch <code>LIN_E_TIMEOUT</code> abgefangen und an das DEM via <code>Dem_SetEventStatus</code> berichtet (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00234" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00234">[SWS_Lin_00234]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00290" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00290">[SWS_Lin_00290]</a>).</p> <p>Kommunikationsfehler bei der Rahmenverarbeitung auf dem Bus meldet der Treiber über <code>LinIf_LinErrorIndication</code> mit dem Fehlertyp <code>Lin_SlaveErrorType</code> (z.&nbsp;B. <code>LIN_ERR_HEADER</code>, <code>LIN_ERR_RESP_STOPBIT</code>, <code>LIN_ERR_RESP_CHKSUM</code>, <code>LIN_ERR_RESP_DATABIT</code>) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00277" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00277">[SWS_Lin_00277]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_00281" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_00281">[SWS_Lin_00281]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_Lin_91140" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_Lin_91140">[SWS_Lin_91140]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_91007" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_91007">[SWS_LinIf_91007]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00866" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00866">[SWS_LinIf_00866]</a>). Sofern der Fehler nicht die Header-Phase betrifft, wertet <code>LinIf</code> den Frame als verloren, meldet den Laufzeitfehler <code>LINIF_E_RESPONSE</code> via <code>Det_ReportRuntimeError</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00359" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00359">[SWS_LinIf_00359]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00729" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00729">[SWS_LinIf_00729]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00735" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00735">[SWS_LinIf_00735]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00743" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00743">[SWS_LinIf_00743]</a>) und informiert obere Schichten mit <code>E_NOT_OK</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00728" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00728">[SWS_LinIf_00728]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00742" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00742">[SWS_LinIf_00742]</a>). Trifft ein neuer Header ein, während noch ein Response erwartet wird, meldet <code>LinIf</code> ebenfalls <code>LINIF_E_RESPONSE</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00846" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00846">[SWS_LinIf_00846]</a>). Bleiben Antworten bei der Knotenkonfiguration aus, wird <code>LINIF_E_NC_NO_RESPONSE</code> erzeugt (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00729" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00729">[SWS_LinIf_00729]</a>). Bei Ausbleiben von Bestätigungen an den <code>LinSM</code> triggert <code>LINSM_E_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinSM_00224" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinSM_00224">[SWS_LinSM_00224]</a>).</p> <p>Ein zentraler Degradations- und Diagnosemechanismus auf LIN-Slaves ist die autonome Verwaltung des <code>response_error</code>-Signals: Bei Stopbit-, Prüfsummen-, Datenbit- oder unvollständigen Übertragungsfehlern setzt <code>LinIf</code> das Fehlersignal auf 1 (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00736" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00736">[SWS_LinIf_00736]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00744" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00744">[SWS_LinIf_00744]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00763" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00763">[SWS_LinIf_00763]</a>) und publiziert den geänderten Wert über <code>Com_SendSignal</code> an das COM-Modul (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00764" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00764">[SWS_LinIf_00764]</a>). Optional wird die Anwendung über <code>&lt;User_ResponseErrorSignalChanged&gt;</code> informiert (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00765" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00765">[SWS_LinIf_00765]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00766" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00766">[SWS_LinIf_00766]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00856" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00856">[SWS_LinIf_00856]</a>). Das Signal wird erst wieder gelöscht, wenn ein übertragener LIN-Rahmen, der das Signal enthält, erfolgreich gesendet und bestätigt wurde (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00747" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00747">[SWS_LinIf_00747]</a>). Treten im Diagnosebetrieb (<code>LinTp</code>) Puffer-Überläufe oder P2-Timeouts auf, bricht <code>LinIf</code> die Übertragung ab und fordert über <code>BswM_LinTp_RequestMode(LINTP_APPLICATIVE_SCHEDULE)</code> die sichere Rückkehr in den Applikationsfahrplan (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00792" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00792">[SWS_LinIf_00792]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_LinIf_00877" href="../spec/record.html?id=SWS_LinIf_00877">[SWS_LinIf_00877]</a>).</p> <p class="ai-note">Dieser Leitfaden basiert auf der AUTOSAR-Classic-Platform-Spezifikation R20-11 für das Modulcluster LIN Communication.</p> </div>
